rules.statement: A mortgage decree, even if not explicitly declared bound and executable, can render property bound and executable for the purposes of a subsequent seizure.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is true it does not completely fulfil the directions in section 201 of the Civil Procedure Code by specifying a day on or before which the money decreed to be due on the mortgage is to be paid, but I think it fulfils the requirements as to which the objection has been taken. The second defendant, therefore, bought the land subject to the mortgage."
